script.cover_1: More work lands on an already full week. Which ask is fair?
script.payoff: The fair ask names what moves aside for the new task.
script.caption: Adding work without moving work is only pressure with a smile. Send this to the friend who says yes to everything.
script.request: A full week, and one more task arrives.
script.pushy: Everyone is busy. You take this also, no choice.
script.professional: This is urgent. Which of your tasks can wait so you can take it?
script.why: It admits the cost and lets the junior say what moves.
script.reply_me: Happy to take it. Which of my current tasks should move, so I can plan it?
